'''Va'Lonis''' was a [[Tarasin]] who played the keyboard in the band [[Distraction]]

==Biography==
Va'Lonis and the band traveled to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-owned [[Yacht/Legends|Yacht]], ''[[Sleemo Poya Jeedai]]'', where they were due to perform at a concert. While they waited for the show to begin, they met with a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were providing them with extra security during the event. They were investigating [[Niklas Cories]], who they believed posed a threat to the band. Va'Lonis claimed that he knew the location of Cories, claiming that he was on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coriesant]], as it was named for his family. He also revealed to them his interpretation of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] and claimed that there were two [[Sith academy|Sith Academies]], a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] Academy and an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] Academy. Va'Lonis and the band performed in the concert and during it, Cories attempted to destroy the ship.

Va'Lonis had a large ego and disagreed with the band's [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] manager, [[Zim Zimley]], over what was best for the band.
